vetSays.line: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Hazel, the person in their 40s, with grey-streaked hair, Nancy and Kawthar met them at the door — 4 put down. Hazel, the person in their 40s, with grey-streaked hair, Nancy, Kawthar are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Choir Toad: Break the chorus. The Resonant Croak needs the chorus — every throat in range joins. SHOUT and the note dies mid-croak. The hum needs the choir; scatter the choir. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Loud Beast: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Inspiration: Be three tiles out. The bloom is the timer: two beats of brightening, then white. Be three tiles out when it flares. The ember beat after is safe — walk in and finish it while it glows itself out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Kavya, Nancy, Kawthar and Jack met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Kavya, Nancy, Kawthar, Jack are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Heckler: WAIT to answer back. SHAME is the damage, not the swing — WAIT to answer back and clear it before the HEADLINER pile-on. The words demand a response. Give them one, on your terms. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Theo just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Terms of Service: Read the fine print — find the loophole. Clauses write themselves and unanswered ones auto-accept, the penalties landing unread. Spend turns examining the scroll and you will find the loophole clause that dismisses it outright. (Striking the scroll just gives it more to bill you for.) (Theo lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🗣️ Theo told Nancy and Kawthar how it went — they were there when it happened.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruby just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Rut King: Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Spool: Feed it nothing. It records your strikes and plays them back. Give it waits and heals while it records and the replay is silence. (At the fire, Amina told Eli, Nancy, Kawthar, and 5 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kavya just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kavya, Nancy, Kawthar, Jack and Theo met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Kavya, Nancy, Kawthar, Jack, Theo are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Landlord: Never end on leased ground. Rent comes due every round you end on leased ground — keep moving and the ledger starves. Each ADDENDUM raises the rent and heals it. Never end two rounds on the same dirt. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nevermore: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Chorus Line: Dance on the downbeat. The kick only lands on beat 4 of the 4/4 count. Dance and it catches air — but dancing is your whole turn. (At the fire, You told Kavya, Nancy, Kawthar, and 2 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kavya just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kawthar just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jack just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kavya, Nancy, Kawthar, Jack and Theo met them at the door — 5 put down. Kavya, Nancy, Theo are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Eulogy: Contradict the narration. It is a STORY and stories need listeners — it narrates you faltering, and the verses count down. Contradict it with your actions: it says you run, you advance. Three true contradictions and the story dismisses you kindly. (It says you falter — do not.) (At the fire, You told Nancy, Kawthar, Jack, and 4 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nostalgia: Keep moving during the spell. The Home Movies beam needs your EYES — keep moving during the SPELL beat and the picture can't hold you. The screen burns brightest just before it fires: that's your two-turn warning. Or break its concentration outright: a stun or shout while the screen burns brightest fizzles the picture. Interruptible — it can only hold one memory at a time. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Suburb: Leave. Navigation is victory. You cannot kill a suburb — the fight is a timer and the Property Tax is the clock. LEAVE. Navigation is victory. (If you must stay: bring the wild inside — a plant, a stray, a rumor — it is sterile and it cannot cope.) (Rosa lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🗣️ Rosa told Kawthar and Theo how it went — they were there when it happened.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Herald: Read the omens — reposition freely. It announces everything — read the omens. It is slow: reposition freely, never trade blows standing still. (It is a tutorial — the real test comes later. Learn it here, cheap.) (Isaac lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🗣️ Isaac told Nancy and Kawthar how it went — they were there when it happened.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big-Eyes: Kill the followers first. The followers sharpen the Ratio — every one of them is damage. Kill the followers and it is just a person with good lighting. (Ratio-ing it is a popularity contest; starving its audience is a plan.) (At the fire, Peyton told Ruby, Nancy, Kawthar, and 3 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Giulia just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fatima just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Giulia and Fatima met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Giulia, Fatima are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big-Eyes: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (At the fire, Peyton told Ruby, Kawthar, Amina, and 1 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big Loud: Say the goodbye — properly, out loud. It wears someone you buried. Every few rounds the face shifts and borrows their swing. Speak to it AS them — say the goodbye properly, out loud — and it loses coherence; the face cannot borrow a swing from someone who has been mourned. (At the fire, Fatima told Ruby, Kawthar, Amina, and 2 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Eater: Poison the meal. It cannot tell good food from bad — it gorges, it does not chew, and it eats the grid first, you second. Feed it spoiled or diseased meat and watch it vomit out the fight. (Or starve the field: burn your own crops and deny it fuel. Guard the pantry — always.) (At the fire, Peyton told Ruby, Kawthar, Amina, and 2 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Network Note: Give it bad notes. It is support — it takes suggestions. Plant a terrible idea (‘the wolf should be SMALLER’) and the memo ‘fixes’ the enemy into uselessness: the lasers never arrive. (Or kill it first — the rare correct focus-the-buffoon call.) (At the fire, Peyton told Ruby, Nancy, Kawthar, and 4 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nightlight: Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Katarina just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Katarina met them at the door — 1 put down. Katarina is hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Spoiler: Fall prone — deliberately. It must tell the truth — and when it announces you will bleed in three rounds, fulfill the spoiler on YOUR terms: fall PRONE, deliberately, when the round comes. The prophecy is satisfied cheaply and the voiceover finds nothing to fatten on. (At the fire, Katarina told Ruby, Nancy, Kawthar, and 4 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — tick: Keep two squares away. Keep 2+ squares away and it's harmless — it can't chase. Don't walk up to it. Latched: burn it off with fire, or let it feed full and drop on its own. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
